subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core rescueWatchdog cron/service-control feature in this PR after a rebase, or keep this recovery work out of core for now?
rationale: The PR adds a new recovery capability with service-control and protocol impact; automation can identify the stale contracts and proof gap, but maintainers need to choose whether this core feature direction is worth sponsoring.

options.title: Require rebase and proof first
options.body: Ask for a rebase onto current cron/protocol contracts plus redacted live managed-gateway repair proof before product approval.

options.title: Maintainer sponsors adoption
options.body: A maintainer can adopt the branch direction and own the security/availability review while preserving current cron behavior.

options.title: Close as not accepted direction
options.body: If core rescue watchdog recovery is not desired now, close this PR and keep broader recovery discussion on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require rebase and proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase onto current cron/protocol contracts plus redacted live managed-gateway repair proof before product approval.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current cron/protocol contract changes that the rescue watchdog implementation must preserve during any rebase.
